description: Public SLA pad geometry boundaries: thickness mapping, wall-slope footprint, object gap, and connector stride.

mutants.description: The public pad Z span must follow wall thickness at zero and 30 mm while wall height stays fixed; each row must also preserve baseline model slice area.
mutants.test_filter: SLA pad wall thickness honors its registered boundaries

mutants.description: Adjacent 45, 67.5, and 90 degree rows must have strictly decreasing X/Y footprint extents while preserving model slice area.
mutants.test_filter: SLA pad wall slope boundaries change the public footprint

mutants.description: The zero-gap empty result and maximum-gap geometry must differ from the representative case.
mutants.test_filter: SLA around-object pad gap boundaries change pad geometry

mutants.description: A zero-stride control must differ from the positive-stride connector geometry.
mutants.test_filter: SLA around-object connector boundaries change pad geometry
